data_fields.name: chance pair at level 1 and 99 (low, high)
data_fields.donor_constant: integer out of 256 per object, e.g. 61 and 245 (Tourist_Trap_Mechanism.java:290 example)

data_fields.name: required level per competing outcome
data_fields.donor_constant: requiredLevel per band (data order, must be highest first)

data_fields.name: gap for certain cast without gear

best_idea: One level-gap chance curve for spell fizzles and skill steps (chance rises with the gap to the requirement, a gear bonus guarantees success at a set gap, a failed cast locks out for 20 s), plus a cumulative-outcome table for competing drops.
decision_why: Frankendom needs one checkable chance curve for spell fizzles and skill steps and a cumulative table for competing drops; the donor shape is simple. Adapt: name the check for what it returns, sort outcome bands in the engine, keep one timer source.
acceptance: Server test asserts castChance(gap 0, focus 0) = 0.80, castChance(gap 10, focus 0) = 1.00, castChance(gap 5, focus 30) = 1.00; a failed cast sets a 20000 ms wait-gate in engine state; a three-outcome table over 10,000 seeded rolls matches its cumulative probabilities within sampling error.
